name: Celery
description: Includes celery stalks, leaves, seeds and celeriac in salads, soups and seasonings.

name: Cereals containing gluten
description: Wheat (such as spelt and Khorasan wheat/Kamut), rye, barley and oats.

name: Crustaceans
description: Crabs, lobster, prawns, scampi and shrimp.

name: Eggs
description: Eggs from all birds, and foods containing egg (mayonnaise, cakes, pasta).

name: Fish
description: All finfish and fish products including Worcestershire sauce, fish sauces and stocks.

name: Lupin
description: Lupin seeds and flour, often found in specialty breads, pastries and pasta.

name: Milk
description: Cow's, goat's and sheep's milk, cheese, butter, yogurt, cream and milk powders.

name: Molluscs
description: Mussels, oysters, squid, octopus, snails and whelks.

name: Mustard
description: Liquid mustard, mustard powder, mustard seeds, dressings, marinades and curries.

name: Peanuts
description: Also known as groundnuts; distinct from tree nuts; found in peanut butter, oils and satay.

name: Sesame seeds
description: Sesame seeds, sesame oil, tahini paste, and toppings on burger buns and hummus.

name: Soya (Soybeans)
description: Tofu, soy milk, soy sauce, edamame beans and textured vegetable protein.

name: Sulphur dioxide and sulphites
description: Preservative used in dried fruits, wine, beer, cider and some meat products (>10mg/kg).

name: Tree nuts
description: Almonds, hazelnuts, walnuts, cashews, pecans, Brazil nuts, pistachios and macadamia nuts.
